subject: english
question:
In the following question, the first and the last parts of the sentence/passage are numbered 1 and 6. The rest of the sentence/passage is split into four parts-P, Q, R, and S. These four parts are not given in their proper order. Read the sentence/passage and find the most logical order of the parts between 1 and 6.

Plants need sunlight to grow.

P: Photosynthesis needs light.

Q: No food is made without it.

R: Leaves turn yellow without it.

S: The plant dies slowly.

6. Sunlight is very important.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3 (PQRS)**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Start with the biological fact: **P** (“Photosynthesis needs light”) explains why plants require sunlight.</li&g
